wording: description: "German income tax prepayments (Einkommensteuer-Vorauszahlungen, § 37 EStG) for individuals, tax year 2026. Covers who pays them, the four due dates (10 March, 10 June, 10 September, 10 December), how the tax office sets the amount from the last assessment, the EUR 400 and EUR 100 minimums, the EUR 600 small-deductions rule, increases, reductions and the 15-month adjustment window, the solidarity surcharge (EUR 20,350 / 40,700 limits, 5.5%, 11.9% mitigation) and church tax riding on prepayments, the year-end balance, the 1% late payment surcharge and 1.8% interest after assessment, and new businesses. Trigger on: Vorauszahlungen, Vorauszahlungsbescheid, estimated tax Germany, quarterly tax Germany, Herabsetzung Vorauszahlungen, Säumniszuschlag, Nachzahlungszinsen. Out of scope: the tariff and the return (de-einkommensteuer-freelancer, de-self-employed-income-tax), trade tax prepayments (de-trade-tax), VAT advance payments (germany-vat-return), corporate tax (de-corporate-tax), non-residents (de-non-resident-tax)."

wording: "Estimated tax" is a US phrase. In Germany the taxpayer does not work out prepayments. The tax office (Finanzamt) sets them in a prepayment notice (Vorauszahlungsbescheid), and the taxpayer pays the amounts printed on it. § 37 EStG has no safe harbour percentage, no annualised method and no penalty for an estimate that turns out too low. What costs money is paying a set amount late, and interest on the final balance.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Individuals whose income tax is not fully collected by withholding:** freelancers, sole traders, partners, landlords, investors with assessed income, and employees with large side income. They pay prepayments on the income tax they are expected to owe for the current year ([§ 37(1) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__37.html)).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Only once a notice sets them.** Prepayments are set by prepayment notice (§ 37(3) sentence 1 EStG). With no notice, nothing is payable in advance. Set money aside.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **When the claim arises.** Each prepayment arises at the start of the calendar quarter in which it is due, or when tax liability begins, if later (§ 37(1) sentence 2 EStG).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Not here:** trade tax prepayments (set by the municipality, `de-trade-tax`), VAT advance payments (`germany-vat-return`), wage tax withheld by an employer (`de-payroll`), and companies (`de-corporate-tax`). Partnership prepayments are set on each partner personally; the partnership itself pays none for income tax. Partners: `de-partners-and-part-year`.

wording: The 2026 solidarity surcharge limits first apply for assessment period 2026 ([§ 6(27) SolzG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/solzg_1995/__6.html)). Older material shows lower limits.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **The starting figure.** Prepayments are measured, as a rule, by the income tax of the last assessment after crediting withholding taxes such as wage tax and investment income tax (§ 37(3) sentence 2 EStG, with § 36(2) number 2). The tax office may adjust them to the tax it expects for the current year (§ 37(3) sentence 3). Adjusting covers a rise and a cut.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Small deductions are ignored.** Church tax paid, childcare costs, own vocational training, school fees (§ 10(1) numbers 4, 5, 7 and 9), the § 10(1a) special expenses, donations (§ 10b), extraordinary burdens (§ 33) and the § 33a amounts are left out if together they do not exceed EUR 600 (§ 37(3) sentence 4).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Always left out.** The § 34a reduction for retained profits and the § 10a(1) pension special expense (§ 37(3) sentences 5 and 6). § 37(3) does not list the § 35 trade tax credit, so the credit is not excluded; if a notice ignores it, apply for an adjustment. For parents: where child benefit does not fully achieve the tax relief for a child's subsistence minimum (§ 31 EStG), the § 32(6) child allowances and the child benefit to be offset are also left out (§ 37(3) sentence 12). The prepayment base is then worked out with child benefit, not with the allowances; the comparison happens only in the assessment.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Rental losses on a new building.** A loss from letting a building counts only for calendar years that begin after it was bought or completed (§ 37(3) sentence 8). If the building is bought before the calendar year in which it is completed, completion takes the place of purchase (sentence 9). Sentence 10 lifts this for buildings with § 7b special depreciation and some older incentives. The same rule applies to a loss from letting another asset within § 21(1) sentence 1 numbers 1 to 3 EStG, with the start of the taxpayer's own use in place of purchase or completion (sentence 11).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Surcharges.** The solidarity surcharge is measured on the prepayments (§ 3(1) number 2 SolzG) and charged only if the base exceeds the limit in the table (§ 3(3)). Above the limit, it is 5.5% of the whole base, but not more than 11.9% of the excess over the limit (§ 4). Worked from § 4, the cap stops biting once the base passes EUR 37,838.28 (single) or EUR 75,676.56 (joint), where 5.5% of the whole base equals 11.9% of the excess. Income tax at the flat rate under § 32d(3) and (4) EStG is left out of the limit test (§ 3(3) SolzG). Joint filers use the EUR 40,700 limit; do not double the single limit by hand. Church tax prepayments are paid with the income tax prepayments ([§ 51a(4) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__51a.html)). The EUR 400 and EUR 100 minimums do not apply to them (§ 51a(4) sentence 1).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **How the yearly amount is split.** § 37 does not print a split across the four dates. Read the amounts from the notice.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Year-end settlement.** Prepayments paid and withholding taxes are credited against the assessed tax ([§ 36(2) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__36.html)). A balance due (Abschlusszahlung) is payable within one month of the assessment notice; the part equal to prepayments due but unpaid is payable at once (§ 36(4) sentence 1). An overpayment is refunded after the notice (§ 36(4) sentence 2).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Prepayments are not a business expense.** Income tax, solidarity surcharge and the late payment surcharge and interest on them may not be deducted from profit or income ([§ 12 number 3 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__12.html): taxes on income "sowie die auf diese Steuern entfallenden Nebenleistungen"; late payment surcharges and interest are Nebenleistungen under [§ 3(4) numbers 4 and 5 AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__3.html)). Book them as private withdrawals. Church tax paid, including church tax prepayments, is the exception: it is a special expense in the year paid ([§ 10(1) number 4 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__10.html)), except church tax on flat-taxed investment income.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Four dates:** 10 March, 10 June, 10 September, 10 December 2026. In 2026 none falls on a weekend. If a deadline ends on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it moves to the next working day ([§ 108(3) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__108.html)).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Day of payment** ([§ 224(2) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__224.html)): a transfer counts on the day the tax office's account is credited; under a SEPA direct debit mandate, on the due date; cash on receipt; a cheque three days after receipt.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **A later increase** adjusts the last prepayment of the year and is payable within one month of the notice (§ 37(4) EStG).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Changing the amount.** A prepayment notice is always set subject to review, and the taxpayer may apply at any time for it to be changed ([§ 164(1) and (2) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__164.html)). Use the Mein ELSTER form "Antrag auf Anpassung von Vorauszahlungen" with a profit projection. The tax office decides at its discretion: § 37(3) sentence 3 EStG says it "kann" adjust, so an application does not by itself change anything. The current notice stays in force until it is replaced ([§ 124(2) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__124.html)), so pay it until a new notice arrives.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Adjustment window.** The tax office may adjust 2026 prepayments until the end of March 2028 (15th month after the year). Longer periods applied for 2019 to 2024 only ([§ 52(35d) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__52.html)).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **New business.** The registration questionnaire (Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung) is due within one month of starting ([§ 138(1b) and (4) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__138.html)). Its expected-profit answer drives the first prepayment notice.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Late payment surcharge** ([§ 240 AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__240.html)). For each started month after the due date: 1% of the overdue tax rounded down to a multiple of EUR 50. None for a delay of up to three days, except for cash or cheques (§ 240(3)). None before the tax is set (§ 240(1) sentence 3), but solidarity surcharge and church tax prepayments are payable with the set income tax prepayments even without their own notice, and that protection does not apply to them (§ 51a(4) sentences 2 and 3 EStG). No surcharge on surcharges or interest (§ 240(2)).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Interest after assessment** ([§ 233a AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__233a.html), [§ 238 AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__238.html)). 0.15% for each full month, on the balance rounded down to EUR 50, both ways. For 2026 it starts on 1 April 2028. Older years had a longer interest-free period: 2019 from 1 October 2021; 21 months for 2020 and 2021, 20 for 2022, 18 for 2023 and 17 for 2024 (the 2024 interest period is Art. 97 § 36(3) number 7(d), distinct from the 16-month § 152 late-filing rule in number 5(d); [Art. 97 § 36(2) and (3) EGAO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/aoeg_1977/art_97__36.html)). Do not carry those periods into 2026. The base is the assessed tax less withholding and less prepayments set before interest starts (§ 233a(3)). Prepayment notices themselves bear no § 233a interest (§ 233a(1) sentence 2). Voluntary payments accepted before the assessment stop interest (§ 233a(8)).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Started versus full months.** The surcharge counts each started month; § 233a interest counts full months only (§ 238(1) sentence 2).
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **Too-low prepayments.** No penalty in § 37. The cost is a larger balance and, after the interest-free period, interest.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **False facts in a reduction application.** Giving the tax office incorrect or incomplete facts that lead to tax being cut is tax evasion, punishable by up to five years' imprisonment or a fine; the attempt is punishable too ([§ 370(1) and (2) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__370.html)). A prepayment notice is a tax assessment (§ 164(1) sentence 2 AO), so a reduction won on false facts falls under it. Do not prepare or file a reduction application on a profit projection you know to be wrong.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - **A client who cannot pay.** The tax office may defer (Stundung) a payment where collecting it when due would be a considerable hardship and the claim is not put at risk; deferral is as a rule granted only on application and against security ([§ 222 AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__222.html)). Apply before the due date. Deferral interest is charged for the deferral period ([§ 234(1) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__234.html)) at 0.5% for each full month ([§ 238(1) AO](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ao_1977/__238.html)). That is not the 0.15% § 233a rate, which § 238(1a) limits to § 233a cases; do not mix them. § 233a interest set for the same period is credited against deferral interest (§ 234(3)). If the hardship comes from lower income, apply for a reduction of the prepayments as well.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - Non-residents with German income assessed under § 49 EStG can also receive prepayment notices; § 37 is not limited to residents. See `de-non-resident-tax`.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - Foreign tax credits and treaty exemptions change the expected tax. If a notice is based on a year before a move, apply for an adjustment. The year of moving in or out: `de-partners-and-part-year`; leaving: `leaving-germany-exit-tax`.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: - Pay in EUR to the tax office's account; the payment day is when the account is credited, so allow for foreign transfer time.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Example 1: freelancer, steady income.** The last assessment showed income tax of EUR 9,600, with EUR 1,200 of investment income tax credited. The base is EUR 8,400. The notice sets four equal prepayments of EUR 2,100. Both minimums are met. EUR 8,400 is below the EUR 20,350 single limit, so no solidarity surcharge. She is a church member in a 9% state: church tax prepayments total EUR 756 for the year, paid with the same instalments.
kind: Source-bound rule/figure; exact selected quotations below

wording: **Example 2: higher earner, mitigation zone and a late payment.** A single sole trader's notice sets income tax prepayments of EUR 22,000 for 2026. That is over the EUR 20,350 limit. 5.5% of 22,000 is EUR 1,210, but the cap is 11.9% of the EUR 1,650 excess, EUR 196.35, so the surcharge prepayments are EUR 196.35 for the year. His 10 September instalment of EUR 5,549 is credited 40 days late. That is two started months. The overdue tax rounds down to EUR 5,500, and the surcharge is 1% x 2 x 5,500 = EUR 110.
